scope: Actual editor functions extracted from source; synthetic fetch/state/clock/auth responses. No real user/project writes or paid AI calls.
results: project refresh preserves last confirmed data and exposes persistent errors for bad responses
definitive auth/access/missing responses clear private state without needing a response body
valid refresh restores data and keeps only a selection that exists in the confirmed project
body timeout settles refresh, releases busy accounting and preserves the confirmed output
older concurrent reads cannot overwrite a newer state or error and background polls do not overlap
unmounted refresh never applies data or error
invalid generation results never announce completion or trigger another paid batch
completion requires a matching confirmed project; failed final reload cannot retain the generation lock
generation body timeout produces a public unknown-result notice and no automatic reissue
quota rejection and partial quota results retain the upgrade notice and stop generation
stalled partial generation keeps the existing bounded retry behavior
double activation and unmount never start an extra generation request
continuing progress remains bounded to twelve batches and only requests pending slides
failed or unreadable generation HTTP responses retain outputs and public errors
